notes: «قال الزهري عن سعيد» — Zuhri is named as a transmitter between Sufyan and Sa'id (rule 5)
«قال سفيان وزاد فيه» opens a second isnad after the saying (rule 4); it is its own group, headed by Sufyan as the text writes him, and the compiler's shaykh is not repeated for it
The Prophet is the end of both chains; the glosses between dashes are left out
The SWI flag refers to this second group
